sentences.en: The "Fisherman's ring" is a red ink stamp representing St Peter on a boat casting out his nets, with the name of the reigning pope.

sentences.en: In business and literary documents red ink was used for contrast, especially in headings; in demotic, however, it is very rarely seen.

sentences.en: The patriarch has therefore the title paxapt&Taros and the right to sign his name in red ink.

sentences.en: The physical appearance of the writing were long spindly characters formed in red ink.

sentences.en: It consisted of frayed reed pens or brushes, a small pot of water, and a palette with two circular cavities in which black and red ink were placed, made of finely powdered color solidified with gum.

sentences.en: I almost expected the completed form to be sent back to me with " Must try harder " scrawled in red ink.

sentences.en: A red ink color called cinnabar used to contain mercury, which caused skin irritation in some people.
